parts.text: In this experiment you will investigate shadows formed on a screen. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1 You are provided with a lamp behind a piece of card. The card has a circular hole which in this experiment is referred to as the light source.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the screen so that its centre is 30.0 cm from the light source.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Measure the diameter d of the circular object card labelled A . d = ............................................ cm [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Place the object card A at a distance x = 2.0 cm from the screen. Switch on the light source. Measure and record in Table 4.1 the diameter s of the shadow of the object card formed on the screen. The screen has a sheet of graph paper taped to it. You may mark the graph paper to assist in measuring the diameter of the shadow.
